Top candidate: **Sett_Rot** (rot at the base causing plant death). Let me view one reference.

The reference Sett_Rot image is a strong match to the test image:
- Same whole-plant wilting/death pattern
- Same straw-tan dried leaves
- Same dark reddish-brown discoloration at the stem base
- Same field/soil environment

This is clearly Sett_Rot — basal rot spreading from the sett (planting piece) upward, causing total leaf dieback.
